title: Implement One-Shot Tuple-Bound Execution Enablement Gate
summary: Record implementation of the FP-MCP-228 one-shot disable-clearance policy in the MCP bridge guarded start path. The bridge now evaluates operator-local clearance inside startRemoteRunnerRequest using the existing read-only clearance observer, binds it to the exact approval id, request id, executionBaseCommit, requestArtifactCommit/current HEAD, branch, model, run mode, and target workspace, and only bypasses the local disable-switch early return when both human approval evidence and operator-local clearance pass. The patch also passes approval id into pre-start evidence validation and includes one-shot clearance proof fields in start request/result metadata. No start tool was called during this packet, so no runner start endpoint was contacted and no canary ran.
caveats: The running MCP service must be restarted before this bridge implementation is active through ChatGPT tools.
This implementation does not create or mutate operator-local clearance and does not clear any standing global switch.
The existing FP-MCP-227 approval and local clearance are time-boxed and may be expired before any future canary attempt; fresh approval/local clearance may be required.
The runner may still enforce its own execution policy; this packet implements the bridge-side one-shot clearance gate only.
The start tool was deliberately not invoked during implementation to avoid runner contact.
No approval consumption evidence was recorded in this packet because no start attempt occurred.
